description:
Princess Yuria and Duke Carlisle will kill anyone who crosses their path. But this is supposed to be a romance novel, not a thriller! Now here I am, transmigrated into the novel and married off to nine-year-old Carlisle years before he and Yuria kill me for coming between them. But all I can think about is how…adorable Carlisle is? What if I raised him to be kind? Once he’s a loving adult, I can just pretend to love someone else and run away before Yuria arrives...right?
